title: Finite complex construction: seed22 L248 dynamic gauge on the k8 word
body:
## Result

Finite scalar construction with a scoped exact optimum; no new selected κ. On the selected PR1094 k8 word, this composes a changing dyadic gauge on L248 with PR1263's other 217 constant gauges. OS assignment seed 22 selects the 23rd sorted eligible helper (zero-based index 22) from the pinned 237-helper inventory. L248 is outside PR1259's seed-37 slice [37:53].

| Orientation | PR1094 baseline | PR1263 constant gauges | Seed-22 mixed word | Increment over #1263 | Total saving |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Forward | 149,002 | 136,002 | 135,912 | 90 | 13,090 |
| Backward | 149,018 | 136,018 | 135,928 | 90 | 13,090 |

The 71-position L248 exponent path is optimized exactly over all integers while the other gauges are frozen. The proof gives a complete finite interval and dynamic program. All coefficient-work initialization/clearing, 217 other gauge boundaries, and 12 L248 scale macros are charged. Both orientations pass the 712-column exact map and three dirty primitive fixtures. Prefix ceilings remain 52/68 bits; denominator depths remain 24/26 under the existing 192-bit local charge. The recursive profile is unchanged, so this does not alter κ or establish native/hosted admission.

## Reproduction

From the repository root:

```sh
python3 -I -O -B research/complex-gauge-composition-seed22/verify.py
python3 -I -O -B research/complex-gauge-composition-seed22/test_package.py
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_COMPLEX_K8_MIXED_GAUGE seed=22 helper=248 incremental=90/90 total=13090/13090 all712=both
PASS_COMPLEX_K8_MIXED_GAUGE_CONTROLS positive=2 orientations negative=7 checks in 4 classes
```

`SOURCES.json` pins base `bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f`, the selected PR1094 archive/lowerer, and vendored source bytes. `RESULT.json` stores full exponent schedules, source identities, hashes and invoices. No selected frontier file or `upstream/` content was changed.

## Overlap, credit, and limits

This is not an independent duplicate of #1259 (which searched a 16-helper slice and chose L276) or #1263 (constant gauges on 218 helpers). It conditions the exact time-varying search on #1263's frozen vector and uses seed 22 to choose L248 outside #1259's slice. Fresh PR/discussion checks found no claim for this mixed L248 schedule. PR #1322/#1310's coupled searches concern common constant gauges, not this changing schedule.

Credit Sagar Thakrar / #1259 for the time-varying one-helper method and Philipp (@mightyOil) / #1263 for the constant-gauge vector and independent literal-price review. The PR696 lowerer and selected PR1094/PR1087 k8/T16 chain are credited in the package NOTICE. Prepared with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance on the user's behalf; no independent human review is claimed. Apache-2.0.

The selected compiler, realization, hosting, precision/tape, analytic and bit-interface assumptions remain. The mixed word has not been admitted through the native supplier/controller and full hosted invoice; that is the next required step before considering adoption.
